name: Maze Munch
hook: One neon maze, everyone munching. Glow, then chomp.
how: Munch dots for points while the spooks hunt you. Eat a glowing orb and for a few seconds you can chomp other players and spooks; in the last 20 seconds a chomp knocks you out. Most points at the buzzer wins.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move; swipe or the on-screen pad on touch
uses: Each player's best round score, shown on the results card.
The host's browser keeps the dots and orbs and decides who chomped whom; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Rounds, the clock and the final 20 seconds are timestamps in shared state, so a new host carries on.
Bot chompers fill the maze until enough people join, and spooks roam it.
Every chomper moves itself and everyone sees it at once.
ideas: Add a cherry that gives 500 points and appears every 20 seconds
Make the maze bigger, with a second tunnel
Make it teams: red chompers against blue
